text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Live Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And with that, all events have come to a 
close!! Claiming the top spot in total 
points this time is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> delivered a splendid, top-tier 
performance in today's trial event!

text_block_list.name: Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Good work, <chrname>. As expected of an active 
Tracen Academy student. That was a 
magnificent performance.

text_block_list.name: Competitor Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Man, the level of competition in this 
tournament is way higher than I imagined. 
I need to get back to training harder!

text_block_list.name: Competitor Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"We plan on participating in next year's 
tournament as well. If fate allows, let's 
have a rematch. We want to compete with 
all of you for the title of No. 1 
athlete!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...All the contestants are already fired 
up for the main tournament. That's how 
fulfilling today's competition was.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And that holds true for both myself and <chrname> 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: —Suzuka-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
I've put together next month's streaming 
schedule. Would you mind taking a look?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll look over it right away.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
...Were you thinking about the test 
tournament?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
With no injuries and no major incidents, 
the tournament was conducted in an 
exceptionally sound manner.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
The survey responses from the 
participating athletes were overwhelmingly 
positive. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
The attendance at the venue and concurrent 
stream viewers only barely scraped past 
our minimum goal.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Public interest is still low... and 
awareness of the tournament itself is 
barely there to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
We need to fix this immediately. If only 
to live up to the athletes' expectations.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna push the PR super hard! And 
really, really hype up the tournament!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
So if there's anything I can do, please 
don't hesitate to ask!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu— Thank you, Elfi. But you're already 
doing more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
In fact, the largest group of spectators 
learned about the U.A.F. through you and 
tuned in. The numbers clearly reflect that 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
If we're going to improve things, we need 
to find another... approach to reach new 
demographics.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: A new demographic, you say...? Hmm...—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. Thinking about that is my 
job."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"As an athlete and as a streamer, give 
everything you have to what you want to 
do."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Because surely that will be the greatest 
help to us.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san...!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us begin the meeting. In order to 
bring even more excitement to the "U.A.F."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the U.A.F. test tournament came to 
a close, and time marched on toward next 
year's main event—
